name: A Mounted Stop
jem_summary: While mounted, hitch a horse to a fence using its special lead slot; remove a pack animal’s chest with shears.

pages.title: A Mounted Stop
pages.text: While mounted, hitch a horse to a fence using its special lead slot; remove a pack animal’s chest with shears.

pages.title: A Mounted Stop
pages.text: Horseshoes and blankets support caring for and dressing transport animals after learning stops and unloading.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Put the lead in the horse’s special slot and interact with a fence while riding. Empty a pack chest safely before shearing; its contents drop. The native inventory-switch button moves between rider and horse views.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Put a lead in the horse's special inventory slot and click a fence while mounted. The horse is leashed to the fence; the lead stays in its slot when detached.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use jump while riding a supported horse in water, or place a horse in a boat. Supported ridden horses can swim and horses can fit in boats.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the inventory-switch button or its configured hotkey while mounted. The rider can move between both inventories; the mounted HUD keeps hunger visible and shows the jump meter when relevant.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use shears on a donkey, mule or llama carrying a chest. The chest is removed and its contents drop.
